description: Inbound proposing a new meeting time from a new contact
subject: Intro call & partnership sync
body:
Hi Micah,

Great connecting on LinkedIn. I would love to schedule a quick 30-minute intro call to discuss how our teams could collaborate.

Are you free next Tuesday, November 3rd at 2:00 PM PST?

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Director of BD, Acme Partners

description: Inbound accepting an existing hold we were waiting on them for
subject: Re: Partnership Sync
body:
Hi Micah,

Tuesday at 2:00 PM PST works perfectly for me. Looking forward to our sync!

Best,
Sarah

description: Inbound counter-proposing a new time when a hold already exists
subject: Re: EmailAgent Demo
body:
Hi Micah,

Something came up and Wednesday morning won't work anymore. Can we reschedule to Thursday, November 5th at 3:00 PM PST?

Warmly,
Elena

description: Inbound cancellation of an active hold
subject: Need to cancel our sync next week
body:
Hey Micah,

I need to cancel our coffee sync next Monday. Our product launch got pulled forward and my schedule is packed. I'll follow up in a couple of weeks once dust settles.

Thanks,
David

description: Inbound support/billing complaint with no calendar intent
subject: URGENT: Double charged on invoice #INV-9281
body:
Hello Support Team,

I just checked our bank statement and we were billed twice for invoice #INV-9281 ($1,499.00 each) on October 27th. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.
